entities.summary: Mar Ignatius Andrew 'Abdul-Ghal Akijan was the Patriarch of the Syriac Catholic Church from 1662 to 1677. His election as patriarch marked the first separation of the hierarchy between the Syriac Catholic Church and the Syriac Orthodox Church.
